title: LiveCreateResponse
description: The created Live session identifier and WebRTC answer. Apply transport.sdp as the peer's remote answer and wait for session.started on the data channel before sending commands.

session.description: The newly created Live session. Use its ID for session controls and sideband connections.

id.description: Opaque session identifier. Preserve the returned value unchanged, including its prefix.

transport.description: WebRTC transport with the SDP answer.

LiveWebRTCTransport.description: WebRTC transport carrying the offer SDP in a creation request or answer SDP in its response.

type.description: The transport used for the Live session. Always `webrtc`.

sdp.description: Session Description Protocol message for the WebRTC connection.
